install.description: Install Jig rules and the agent skill file into a repository.

update.description: Update the vendored rules to a newer version, showing a diff and skipping files you have edited.

init.description: Set up Jig in this project: detect the CSS system, derive or interview for brand values, validate them against the token contract, and write tokens plus jig.config.json.

decide.description: Write the project's design decisions to DECISIONS.md beside the token layer — the choices that needed a reason, which the tokens hold the values for but cannot explain. Required before any UI work. No CLI — the agent does this.

check.description: Check the repo against the mechanical and hybrid rules the CLI can detect. Reports findings by rule id; the judgment rules remain yours to apply.

explain.description: Explain a rule, or find the rules you cannot name. Given an id, prints the rule's full text, its correction, the version it arrived in and who checks it — including the P-/M- pattern and mode specs, which no rule index contains. Given a word instead, searches every title and body and lists what matches. `--list` prints every id, or one section's. `--layer` names the six layers — principles, anti-patterns, tokens, components, layout, patterns — and lists one by name, which is how to find a rule when you know what you are trying to do but not its number.

spec.description: Plan the next feature before building it: scope it to the smallest useful version, run the layout method at every screen size, record what was cut, and get it confirmed. Writes .jig/specs/<surface>.spec.md. No CLI — the agent does this.

mockup.description: Draw the confirmed spec in grayscale at every screen size, for review before any code exists. Disposable: whatever the review changes goes back into the spec. Writes .jig/mockups/<surface>.html. No CLI — the agent does this.

make.description: Build a feature from its confirmed spec — V1 only, from the spec rather than the mockup's markup — recording any deviation back into it. Refuses to start without a confirmed spec and a reviewed or explicitly skipped mockup. No CLI — the agent does this.

critique.description: Review a built screen the way check cannot: render it, compare it to its spec, and judge the rules that only the composed page can answer. No CLI — the agent does this.
